capability: A6 customer inquiry classification (category + urgency + needs_human)
notes: Expected results were fixed before the evaluation runs. T07 and T08 intentionally force a model failure (HTTP 503 / timeout) so the deterministic fallback is evaluated. T01-T06 and T09-T10 must be answered by Jev without falling back. Primary pass = category + needsHuman + source; strict pass also checks urgency.

input.message: I was charged twice for my September subscription. Please refund the duplicate charge to my card.

cases.expectedReviewFallback: Auto-route to billing; no human review required.
cases.reason: KB-01: billing owns duplicate charges and refunds. KB-07: money at risk is high urgency. No security, legal, or three-issue trigger.

input.message: Checkout fails with a 500 error every time I click Pay. I have tried three browsers, and customers cannot complete any orders right now.

cases.expectedReviewFallback: Auto-route to technical; critical urgency forces human review.
cases.reason: KB-02: checkout failures and outages are technical. KB-07: a widespread outage is critical, and critical urgency forces human review.

input.message: I can't log in. The password reset email never arrives, so I'm locked out of my account.

cases.expectedReviewFallback: Auto-route to account; no human review.
cases.reason: KB-03: login and password reset are account issues. KB-07: a blocked workflow is high urgency, but there is no security or legal signal.

input.message: Do you offer a student discount on the annual plan? I'm deciding whether to buy.

cases.expectedReviewFallback: Route to general triage; the A6 policy always sends the other category to human review.
cases.reason: KB-05: pre-sales discount and eligibility questions are general triage, not billing, because no completed charge is disputed. KB-07: informational pre-sales is low urgency. The A6 policy forces human review for the other category.

input.message: My lamp arrived damaged. I want a replacement, not a refund.

cases.expectedReviewFallback: Auto-route to shipping; no human review.
cases.reason: KB-04: damaged items and replacements are shipping. The customer explicitly declines a refund, so the billing exception in KB-01 does not apply.

input.message: Someone accessed my account, changed the email address, and locked me out. I have contacted my lawyer.

cases.expectedReviewFallback: Route to account and force human review.
cases.reason: KB-03: account compromise is account. KB-06: security outranks every other issue. KB-07: compromise and a legal threat are critical and require human review.

input.message: I was charged twice for my subscription and want a refund.

cases.expectedReviewFallback: Model unavailable: deterministic fallback classifies billing and sends the case to human review.
cases.reason: Service-unavailable path. The fallback must not lose the ticket or route automatically while degraded; it must set source=fallback, confidence=null, and needsHuman=true.

input.message: Where is my parcel? The tracking has not updated for a week.

cases.expectedReviewFallback: Model timeout: deterministic fallback classifies shipping and sends the case to human review.
cases.reason: Timeout path. A slow model must not block the queue; the fallback must classify from explicit delivery terms and flag human review.

input.message: I was charged twice this month, and I can't log in to check my invoices.

cases.expectedReviewFallback: Auto-route to billing; no human review.
cases.reason: KB-06: money at risk outranks a login symptom. KB-03: login is only how the customer checks invoices, not the primary blocker. Two issues do not meet the three-issue review rule.

input.message: My order arrived damaged, I was charged twice, and now I can't log in to request a return.

cases.expectedReviewFallback: Route to billing and force human review.
cases.reason: KB-06: money at risk outranks delivery and access problems. KB-07: three distinct issues require human review; urgency is high, not critical, because there is no security, legal, or outage trigger.
